 Karnataka School Examination and Assessment Board to prepare state-level I PU exam papers for 2027

 TNN / Nov 08, 2026, 23:19 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Bengaluru: Question papers for the I PU annual examination — scheduled for 2027 — will be prepared at the state level. An order has been issued by the school education department entrusting this responsibility to Karnataka School Examination and Assessment Board (KSEAB). However, the board will not conduct the exam itself; it will continue to be held under the leadership of the department of school education (PU). A uniform exam timetable, applicable to all PU colleges across the state, will be prepared for the conduct of these exams. On the day of the exam, question papers will be transmitted to colleges in digital format. Only the practical exam for the first-year PU course will be conducted according to a timetable prepared at the district level. Although the question papers are prepared at the state level, evaluation will take place at the college level. The results will be published only after they have been reviewed and approved by the respective district deputy directors. “This measure will enable the department to monitor the quality of education as early as I PU stage. Furthermore, it will pave the way for improving the pass percentage in the II PU exam,” said school education minister Madhu Bangarappa.
